whyItMatters: laravel SQL assembles from parts (DB::raws*([^)]*(?:"[^"n]*$|.s*$)), so untrusted input rewrites the statement.
actions: Rewrite with parameter bindings, binding every value.
Map dynamic identifiers through an allowlist.
Re-run the scan and confirm no assembled query remains on untrusted input.
verification: Rescan shows no assembled query on untrusted input, and quote payloads stay inert.
